live.title: This was never a slide deck
live.body: It is a web app. Every number below is counted from the app itself, right now.

controls.title: Go on, change it
controls.body: Pick a colour, a slide design or a transition. The whole app changes, not just this slide.
controls.phone: Open the guide on your phone

prompt.title: One prompt can build this app
prompt.body: The stack, the content, every section, presenter mode, the diagrams, the themes and the accessibility rules, written down as a single prompt you can read and reuse.

thanks.title: Thank you for your patience
thanks.body: Pick one habit and try it this week. The guide will be here whenever you need it.
